t: This is Russell Square station, on Bernard Street in Bloomsbury, in the London Borough of Camden. It's near Russell Square itself. The station is on the Piccadilly line between Holborn and King's Cross St Pancras, in fare zone 1. Its architect was Leslie Green, an English architect best known for the stations he designed in central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. Look for the oxblood red faïence blocks, the pillars and the semi-circular first-floor windows. Inside, his stations have patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
